name: 01247 · North Adams, MA
findings: ZIP 01247 (North Adams) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01247 (North Adams) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01247 (North Adams) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.
